title: rubia fruticosa subsp. periclymenum
intro: Rubia fruticosa subsp. periclymenum, commonly known as Garden Madder, is a perennial plant species in the Rubiaceae family, known for its vibrant red root and its use in traditional medicine. The plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Rubia fruticosa subsp. periclymenum include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include anthraquinones, such as rubiadin and rubic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
